purpose: Relay I/O, MLS ingest, task bootstrap publish/fetch. S2 adds publishTaskStateSync: reads IDB task state, encrypts a TaskStateSyncPayload with NIP-44, and publishes a kind-30078 event to relays after a successful invite.

public_api.name: publishTaskStateSync
public_api.signature: async function publishTaskStateSync(groupId: string, inviteePubkeyHex: string, signer: EventSigner, client: MarmotClient, relays: string[]): Promise<void>
public_api.description: Loads and replays task events for the group, builds a TaskStateSyncPayload, NIP-44 encrypts it to the invitee, signs a kind-30078 event, and publishes it. All errors are caught internally and logged — the function never rejects.

events_emitted: kind-30078 (task state sync event) — published to relays
test_targets: publishTaskStateSync catches and logs errors without rethrowing
publishTaskStateSync skips publish when signer has no nip44
publishTaskStateSync omits deleted tasks (only live tasks included)
